verdict.rationale: Bolt has a dedicated 'connect-mcp' docs page and offers a GitHub MCP connector, so Bolt's agent can use that server's tools to search code, pull in issues, and read or create issues and pull requests. The evidence only shows this one first-party connector, not a general way to plug in arbitrary MCP servers. Missing for 10: evidence of adding custom or third-party MCP servers beyond GitHub, configuration details (transport, auth, tool permissions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.
